approach: Custom static recompilation developed with ChatGPT, following the author's Starter SNES instructions.
notes: Version 1.2.0 adds an optional experimental 60 FPS presentation lock with optimized rendering. It is off by default, controlled by a shared toolbar checkbox and Settings menu option, with a one-time notice. Original NTSC timing remains the default. It supports normal 4:3 presentation and optional Widescreen rendering, expanded gameplay on all four sides and a reflowed information console.
